subject: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)
body:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Scott <evan_scott@redwoodinference.com>, Fatima Noor <fatima_noor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)
Attachments: Regulated-Pilot-CS-Handoff-Checklist-v1.pdf, QBR-Template-Regulated-Pilots-v1.pptx

Team — pulling together handoff for the two regulated pilots that just hit closeout.

Accounts:
1) NorthBridge Banking (VPC Private pilot) — closeout was Tue 6/10
2) Helix Health System (PHI-adjacent, VPC) — closeout was Wed 6/11

Goal of this thread:
- confirm owner transition (Sales/SE -> CS/TAM)
- lock success metrics + what we’ll report in QBR
- schedule QBR (target: within 30 days of “pilot -> rollout” decision, or earlier if procurement drags)

Proposed ownership:
- CS Exec Sponsor: Jasmine
- TAM / day-to-day: Liam
- Sales stays engaged for commercial close + exec alignment: Stephanie/Avery
- SE stays “on call” for 2 weeks post-handoff for any install/auth/logging regressions: Markus/Evan/Fatima

Handoff checklist (attached) — minimum required before CS takes point:
A) Technical / deployment
- final architecture diagram (as-deployed) + networking notes (VPC endpoints, TLS termination, outbound allowlists)
- identity setup: SSO/SAML state + any workarounds (esp. NorthBridge metadata validation issue)
- logging + audit: what is enabled, export destination, retention expectations
- SLOs for: latency (p50/p95), availability, throughput, and any batch windows
- runbook: escalation path + contacts + incident comms expectations

B) Measurement / outcomes
- pilot success criteria and current status (met / partially met / open)
- benchmark summary (what was measured; model variants; dataset constraints)
- open risks + mitigation (security/procurement/infra)

C) Commercial / process
- procurement timeline + stakeholders
- evidence pack requests outstanding + SLA/DPA redlines (if any)
- credits/discounts used for pilot + any guardrails

Asks:
1) Markus/Evan/Fatima — can you drop the “as-deployed” notes + runbook bullets for both accounts by EOD Fri?
2) Avery/Stephanie — can you confirm the success metrics we should track in QBR for each (see below) and whether we need exec sponsor presence?
3) Liam — once we have the above, can you propose 2–3 QBR slots for each customer (late June / early July)?

Draft QBR metrics (feel free to adjust):
- performance: p50/p95, tokens/sec, error rate, fallback rate (if used)
- cost: $/1M tokens estimate under expected prod load; batching/caching impact
- security/compliance: audit log coverage, retention/residency alignment, SSO status
- operational readiness: dashboards in place, on-call/escalation paths, change management

Notes from closeouts (high level):
- NorthBridge: security team is satisfied directionally; still sensitive on audit export schema + wants SAML edge case fully resolved (related: SUP-51214).
- Helix: deciding Dedicated vs Private; procurement wants clearer packaging language and implementation timeline.

Thanks — once we align, I’ll update the CS handoff tracker and the exec readout.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Customer Success (Regulated)
Redwood Inference


---

From: Evan Scott <evan_scott@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Fatima Noor <fatima_noor@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 10:02 AM PT
Subject: Re: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)

+1. We can get you the as-deployed notes.

NorthBridge quick summary (will add more detail to handoff doc):
- Topology: Private in customer VPC, peered to app VPC, outbound to their SIEM collector + KMS endpoint.
- Auth: SAML SSO enabled; the metadata validation issue was on NorthBridge IdP side + we have the workaround documented. SUP-51214 is resolved but I’ll paste the final steps into the runbook.
- Logging: audit logs enabled; exporting JSON lines to their S3 bucket via scheduled exporter.
- SLO targets they agreed for pilot: p95 < 1.2s @ 250 tps (short-form assist), error rate < 0.5%.

Helix:
- Still in “decision” mode re: Dedicated vs Private. Current pilot is VPC-based (not on-prem).
- Logging requirement is stricter (wants audit exports to land in their Splunk HEC). We validated feasibility; still need to confirm fields they care about.

We’ll deliver runbook bullets by tomorrow.

Evan
Solutions Engineering


---

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Scott <evan_scott@redwoodinference.com>, Fatima Noor <fatima_noor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)

Confirmed on success metrics for NorthBridge:
- “Green” if we can show: (1) p95 latency under 1.2s at their target concurrency, (2) audit logging + export meets their control evidence requirements, (3) SSO stable with their IdP.
- “Commercial” definition of success for us: security sign-off + move to procurement (they said July target).

Exec sponsor:
- I’d like Stephanie to attend the first QBR for NorthBridge if it’s positioned as rollout readiness + procurement alignment. Customer will have head of platform + security manager; they’ll likely pull in their VP Eng.

For Helix:
- They’re evaluating use cases across departments. We should keep QBR lighter-weight and focus on the plan + timeline. Their pain is implementation predictability more than raw latency.

Also: they asked again on “retention controls” language in the contract. We’ll keep Legal looped on that separately but it may come up in QBR.

Avery
Account Executive
Redwood Inference


---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 12:08 PM PT
Subject: Re: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)

Agree with Avery.

NorthBridge:
- First QBR should be framed as: “Pilot outcomes + rollout plan + what remains for security/procurement.”
- Please include a slide that makes the “what Redwood owns vs what customer owns” explicit (audit export ops, key rotation, SIEM ingestion, etc.). That’s where regulated deals stall.

Helix:
- Keep it focused on timeline + resourcing. If they opt for Dedicated instead of Private, we need to be crisp on what changes operationally.

Ben — FYI, this is a good proof point for the ABM readout (QBR cadence and what assets helped in security review).

Stephanie
NA Sales Leader

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 2:37 PM PT
Subject: Re: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)

Got it. I’ll take day-to-day once we have the checklist complete.

QBR scheduling proposal (pending customer confirmation):
- NorthBridge: Wed 6/25 10:00–11:00am PT OR Thu 6/26 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Helix: Tue 6/24 9:00–9:45am PT OR Mon 6/30 2:00–2:45pm PT

I’ll send holds internally once Rachel confirms who’s attending each.

Also: for NorthBridge, can someone confirm the monitoring dashboard link we used in the closeout? I want to make sure CS has access (read-only) before we present anything.

Liam O’Rourke
Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam_orourke@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Evan Scott <evan_scott@redwoodinference.com>, Fatima Noor <fatima_noor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 4:42 PM PT
Subject: Re: Pilot handoff to CS + QBR scheduling (NorthBridge + Helix)

Perfect.

Attendees:
- NorthBridge QBR: Jasmine + Liam + me; Stephanie + Avery (commercial); Markus optional (only if we think we’ll get deep audit-export questions)
- Helix QBR: Jasmine + Liam + me; Avery optional; SE only if Helix brings IT security (TBD)

Liam — please go ahead and place internal holds for:
- NorthBridge: Wed 6/25 10–11am PT
- Helix: Tue 6/24 9–9:45am PT
We’ll adjust if customers can’t make.

Evan — re: dashboard link, please DM me the Console dashboard URL and I’ll ensure CS access is provisioned. Also please include in the runbook:
- who owns rotating the export credentials
- expected delay/lag for audit export job

Everyone — reminder: keep claims tight on “retention controls.” We should describe current configuration options and what is customer-managed in Private, not imply anything beyond what Security/Legal has approved.

Thanks all. I’ll mark CS ownership effective Monday after the handoff doc is complete.

Rachel
